vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: There is no fixed version of this advisory and there will not be one, so a version bump cannot clear it. The package is not imported. govulncheck reports this at module level, not package or symbol level, so the vulnerable package is not in the CLI's import graph. The only import from golang.org/x/crypto is golang.org/x/crypto/scrypt, in cli/internal/cmd/agents_openclaw.go. Re-verified by the cli-vuln-scan job in .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push and pull request.
